brief:
The Palestinian Meteorological Department expects Thursday to bring hot, dry conditions in mountainous areas and extreme heat across other regions, Shehab Wire reported. A slight decline in temperatures is anticipated, though readings will remain above their seasonal average.

The forecast suggests little relief from the heat wave affecting the Palestinian territories. Residents in lower-lying areas face the most severe conditions, while elevated regions will experience moderately hot weather paired with low humidity levels.
